description:
Welcome to How to Handyma'am—your digital workbench for picking up power tools, conquering home repairs, and throwing DIY intimidation out the window!

We are Samantha, Emily, and Arly: two licensed builders and a professional handyma'am from Lansing, Michigan on a mission to empower women to take control of their own spaces. No gatekeeping, no boring contractor jargon, and zero judgment.

What you'll find here every week:
🛠️ Step-by-Step DIY Tutorials (Drywall, plumbing, power tools & more)
🎙️ The How to Handyma'am Podcast (Real project realities)
🧠 SideQuests: Fast-paced tool trivia & absolute studio chaos

Hit Subscribe, grab your safety glasses, and welcome to the clubhouse!

🔗 CONNECT WITH US:
🌐 Website: howtohandymaam.com
📸 Instagram: @HowToHandymaam
📬 Q&A / Contact: hthm@myhandymaam.com
